dependency_edges.handoff: Five cleaned indicators feed TF-IDF and keyword ranking.
Review text and keywords feed the sentiment model.
Quarterly indicators feed correlation diagnostics and difference equations.
Fitted indicator changes feed standardized PCA variables.
Principal components feed product-specific success indices.
Index comparisons motivate sensitivity and update checks.
Sentiment and keyword ranks feed product design actions.
Success-index tracking feeds the marketing memo.
Sensitivity boundaries condition the manager recommendation.
Difference-equation direction supplies the next-quarter caution in the letter.
